Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.20.0
New Tool: Surface Mosaic, found under Star Stuff. This allows you to build a mosaic image from panel shots of the lunar surface, solar surface, or if you have your own satellite in orbit of Mars, planetary surface mosaics. The machinery borrows a lot from the Planetary Stacker surface mode to find similar patch, do coarse matching then subpixel phase correlated matching. There is also the option to solve for rotated frames, perfect for Alt Az mounts where there may be rotation between each panel.
